comparisons.peer_summary: AMD agreed to acquire ZT Group Int'l, Inc. (ZT Systems) in August 2024 to extend data center infrastructure capabilities and accelerate time to market for AI solutions, with expected closure in the first half of fiscal 2025 subject to regulatory approvals and intent to seek a strategic partner for ZT's manufacturing business.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies disclose strategic acquisitions to expand their data center and AI infrastructure capabilities to capture emerging demand. NVDA focuses on introducing new technologies and services like DGX Cloud to meet unknown long-term trajectories, while AMD explicitly details the acquisition of ZT Systems to extend data center infrastructure capabilities and accelerate time to market for AI training and inferencing solutions. Both actions reflect a response to the same market driver: the rapid growth and infrastructure demands of generative AI.

sentences.text: We build technology and introduce products for new and innovative use cases and applications such as our NVIDIA DGX Cloud services, Omniverse platform, LLMs, and generative AI models.

We also focused on extending our data center infrastructure capabilities by entering into an agreement in August 2024 to acquire ZT Group Int'l, Inc. (ZT Systems), a provider of AI and general purpose compute infrastructure for hyperscale computing companies.
We believe that with the acquisition of ZT Systems, we can accelerate time to market for our leadership AI training and inferencing solutions.
